criteria.intent: Correct and explainable repository, content, website and control routing
criteria.automated_scope: T01 reuses the maintained selection suite through its existing named bridge. It verifies exact review-template ownership, mixed/unknown/control coverage and existing profile accounting. It does not implement or verify the future three-lane classifier, complete diff semantics or source-bound lane reports.

criteria.intent: A genuine protected repository-only merge without website deployment work
criteria.automated_scope: No deterministic check in T01 establishes the future repository-only admission outcome. Its own shared-control PR still requires the current staging route.

criteria.intent: Integrate the existing content lane with accepted platform and complete intervening-history evidence
criteria.automated_scope: T01 provides no content release, accepted-engine compatibility or recovery evidence. The existing issue5 and PR79 retain this work.

criteria.intent: Preserve applicable website and control coverage, budgets, profiles and source architecture
criteria.automated_scope: Existing owning selection regressions preserve their coverage subset. The nine maintained T02-P synthetic installed-graph methods run through the existing locked-venv permanent Python route, explicitly required by COVERAGE; they are not invoked by this standard-library owning-policy job. They cover the exact four-record compatibility set and version/metadata/inventory/extras boundaries. Actual installed91-package verification, advisory clearance and Semgrep execution remain source-bound external evidence. The style guard proves only its enforced subset; applicable CS01/CS04/CS05/CS08/CS09/CS10 review remains separate.

criteria.intent: Admission cannot exempt itself or accept an impersonated or invalid result
criteria.automated_scope: T01 changes no admission producer, workflow or protection. Existing selector tests do not establish trusted-producer enforcement or protected-check transition.

criteria.intent: Preserve accepted-site provenance and concurrency after repository-only merges
criteria.automated_scope: T01 supplies no new publication-baseline, intervening-history, lease or recovery evidence.

criteria.intent: Four actual independent roles and actionable test handoff for each coherent candidate
criteria.automated_scope: No deterministic check can establish separate nonauthoring execution, semantic requirement quality, independent test oracles or actual exploratory observations.

criteria.intent: Source-bound delivery, complete lane outcomes, documentation and measured result
criteria.automated_scope: Current catalog/RI freshness and CI coupling checks establish their mechanical subsets only. Actual CI, staging, merge, postmerge, real lane outcomes and eventual timing evidence remain external obligations.

ROUTING.description: Complete AC01's maintained lane/control decision table, additions/deletions/renames/type-change and mixed/unknown/incomplete-ref evidence, plus exact source/base/policy reports. T01 establishes only the exact review-template subcondition; the whole criterion remains pending.

REPOSITORY-LANE.description: Observe a real protected repository-only merge after applicable source/RI/acceptance and independent-role checks, without hosted preview, website staging, alias or publisher actions. Demonstrate a changed RI executable failure blocks admission. Not delivered by T01.

CONTENT-LANE.description: Reconcile issue5/PR79's actual independent content release and recovery. Authenticate accepted engine/schema and complete accepted-site S through repository-only M to content C history; invalid content/media/references, incompatible or unknown intervening inputs must fail or require fresh website validation. Not delivered by T01.

COVERAGE.description: Inspect changed owners and actual required CI to confirm baseline, permanent source, website/control, staging and production obligations, budgets, failure propagation and provenance. Preserve optional diagnostics and review applicable unautomated style rules. T01 requires the existing broad shared-control coverage; future lane-level preservation remains pending. Approved T02-P requires source-bound execution of all nine unchanged test_python_toolchain.py methods by the existing tools/run_repository_tests.py runner under the complete locked venv in owner-stage prepublication, with complete module/test accounting and no failures or skips. Four owning-policy checks alone do not establish that execution. Also require actual complete91-package installed-graph verification with exactly four individually required Semgrep compatibility records, unchanged metadata, complete current Python advisory coverage without waivers, real CE positive/negative controls and full expected source scan coverage. Preserve every other existing pin, npm disposition, workflow, budget and failure boundary.

TRUST.description: Demonstrate trusted evaluator and workflow/check-producer identity against the actual ruleset before migration. Candidate policy/wrapper changes cannot exempt or impersonate admission. Reject same-name foreign producers, wrong source/run/attempt and missing/failed/skipped/cancelled/stale required evidence; distinguish explicit inapplicability without Pending deadlocks. Not delivered by T01.

PROVENANCE.description: Verify repository/controller and accepted site/platform/content/artifact identities independently after repository-only merge. Prove complete intervening compatibility or use fresh staging, without relabeling old artifacts. Exercise fresh-base decisions, source/predecessor leases and timing/recovery cases that preserve newer accepted content. Not delivered by T01.

REQUIREMENTS.description: Actual separate nonauthoring Requirements & Acceptance Reviewer checks original intent, requirement quality, AC/check/gate traceability before dependent implementation, after material changes and on the completed candidate. Retain exact-source conclusions and unresolved decisions; task-definition review alone does not accept implementation.

REVIEW.description: Actual separate nonimplementing Code Reviewer inspects the complete candidate, tests, policy and RI integration, including applicable CS01/CS04/CS05/CS08/CS09/CS10. Record independent findings, scope and source; actually recheck affected corrections.

WHITEBOX.description: Actual distinct White-box QA independently inspects changed branches, boundaries, invariants and tests; records risk-to-oracle mapping, meaningful fault detection and actual source-bound results or execution gaps. It cannot accept tests or implementation it authored.

EXPLORATORY.description: Actual distinct Exploratory/Interaction QA executes a bounded intent-derived charter on the changed selector/CLI or later applicable surface. Record environment, actions, expected/observed outcomes and regression/manual dispositions. Selection plans are not test passes; unavailable access is not non-applicability.

DELIVERY.description: Fetch current owning issue/PR, exact source CI including Basic and required selection, independent-role results and all applicable external gates. Reconcile actual issue checkboxes and one documentation/RI contract. T01 supplies only its increment; real lane outcomes and queue/setup/execution timing comparisons remain pending without fabricated speed claims. T02-P is the approved prerequisite: park PR124, deliver one bounded repair from protected main through current gates, report/reconcile, then resume already approved T02 with integration review and fresh exact-source evidence. T02-P.1 through T02-P.5 are tracked in the live issue; no whole parent criterion is established by this repair.

MERGED.description: Use the maintainer-approved step scope to complete current staging/admission, protected-main merge and postmerge verification. Record tested source separately from merged commit/tree, then report and propose the next step for separate approval. All whole ACs remain open after T01; no production activation is requested.
